notes.title: Hunting the mainframe
notes.notes:
[previewyoutube=t3peA3TAT_w;leftthumb][/previewyoutube]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35975428/064c53c301f50be69d7c7c3d3e988b4baf549c1d.png[/img]You start in your spaceship, sit on the control chair, and start travelling in hyper speed. You receive an incoming message from the H.Q.: they found the enemy base and you are going there. Your mission is to navigate through the base, avoid obstacles, fight squid robots and reach the mainframe that controls them all.
All game has been reviewed, ship interior is simpler, and improved.
The main game has also been simplified and built on the main game mechanics of the space combat, and ship controlling.
One of the best improvements is the introduction of checkpoints, that allow you to respawn in the last saved position and not to lose your progresses.

notes.title: A brand new evolved game!
notes.notes: Space Space has changed! It's a brand new game, evolved from the old one. Don't lose your opportunity to shoot robot squids, navigate through the squid's base, and have fun with the combat simulator inside the ship. There are also some little mysteries and surprises inside... Welcome to the Space Space ship!

notes.title: The Open World Update
notes.notes: Space Space has changed a lot since the first version, has been optimized, and made open world. Jack Diamonds has found the secret plan of the robot squids to destroy the human race. There is a portal somewhere out in the space, and he has built a special probe, to catch the portal signal and locate it. Follow the probe and it'll lead you at the portal, then you'll have to mine space rocks, hunt the mysterious red squid, and collect five red energy dot, to throw into the portal, open it and teleport your ship to the squid's boss. You'll also need to prepare yourself increasing your resistance to the missiles hits, collecting green energy dots. Your enemies, the robot squids, will chase you all the time, and your ship now, is able to move in many different ways, aim and hit the target. I also created a 3D GUI in which you can make Jack change the game settings, walking inside the ship. If you are new to the game you can learn how to fly the ship in the training room.
